scheduler_source_of_truth: live ChatGPT automation registry for this account
namespace_policy: Only this five-loop stack may write under automation_intelligence/omega_stack/. Other schedulers must use separate namespaces.
global_manifest_policy: Read-only contextual input. Do not use automation_intelligence/manifest.json as this stack's scheduler source of truth and do not overwrite unrelated scheduler topology fields.
persistence_policy: heartbeat.json is the only mutable IN_PROGRESS marker; checkpoint.json is mandatory immediately after bootstrap and after material deltas; substantive work stops by 35m; stale prior-cycle heartbeat >=45m is recovered instead of suppressing the next hourly run; pass 8 freezes RUN_CORE into checkpoint; pass 9 writes immutable core/history using GitHub blob SHAs; pass 10 promotes latest and creates immutable finalization receipt; only receipt-verified runs are fully persisted.

migration.v2_reason: Old agent branch diverged substantially from main; v2 starts from current main and carries only approved design/operational scaffolding.

persistence_bootstrap.rule: No substantive work before verified heartbeat AND verified BOOTSTRAPPED checkpoint. Every run must enter closure by 35m; stale prior-cycle state >=45m is preserved as incident/checkpoint evidence then reset for the new trigger.
github_first_actions: acquire connected GitHub app/tool; fail closed if unavailable
recover stale prior-cycle heartbeat/checkpoint when age >=45m and no valid finalization exists
fetch own heartbeat.json immediately before write
update heartbeat.json with current RUN_ID and IN_PROGRESS using fresh content SHA
write and re-fetch checkpoint.json with BOOTSTRAPPED
persistence_bootstrap.on_github_bootstrap_failure: Re-fetch heartbeat, reconcile, retry exactly once with fresh content SHA. If still unsuccessful, stop substantive work and attempt a Library failure receipt.
closure: By 35m stop new substantive/external work and enter closure.
Pass 8 freezes RUN_CORE into checkpoint.json with FROZEN_FOR_FINALIZATION; re-fetch and verify.
Pass 9 creates immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json and history/<RUN_ID>.json and records GitHub blob SHAs.
Pass 10 promotes latest.json, creates immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json binding current blob SHAs, re-fetch verifies receipt, then marks checkpoint FINALIZED and heartbeat IDLE/FINALIZED.
